derivation: probably from H2596 (חָנַךְ) in the sense of tasting;
def: properly, the palate or inside of the mouth; hence, the mouth itself (as the organ of speech, taste and kissing)

words.word: to the roof of my mouth
and the roof of thy mouth
to the roof of his mouth
to the roof of thy mouth

occurrences.text: Is there iniquity in my tongue? cannot my taste discern perverse things?
Doth not the ear try words? and the mouth taste his meat?
Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul.
For the ear trieth words, as the mouth tasteth meat.
How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.
words: to the roof of my mouth

occurrences.text: For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb, and her mouth is smoother than oil:
For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
His mouth is most sweet: yea, he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, and this is my friend, O daughters of Jerusalem.
And the roof of thy mouth like the best wine for my beloved, that goeth down sweetly, causing the lips of those that are asleep to speak.
words: And the roof of thy mouth

occurrences.text: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst: the young children ask bread, and no man breaketh it unto them.
words: to the roof of his mouth

occurrences.text: And I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth, that thou shalt be dumb, and shalt not be to them a reprover: for they are a rebellious house.
words: to the roof of thy mouth

occurrences.text: Set the trumpet to thy mouth. He shall come as an eagle against the house of the Lord, because they have transgressed my covenant, and trespassed against my law.
